Hero.lead: Loading, transport, delivery: you pick the date, we take care of the rest.

Services.title: Our services
Services.s1d: Houses and apartments: loading, transport and delivery. The price covers labour, the vehicle and insurance of the goods. It depends on volume in m³, fragility, floor and distance, and is set out on the quote.
Services.s2d: Offices and retail premises: the job is scheduled on the quote to limit disruption. The price follows volume, fragility, floor and distance.
Services.s3d: Transport of your goods in France and abroad. Distance is part of the quote, with the same professional insurance of the goods carried.
Services.s4d: Delivery and placement of furniture bought, sold or given away. The quote states volume, floor and distance.
Services.s5d: Loading or unloading a vehicle, without handling the whole move. The job is priced on quotation.

Process.title: How it works
Process.s1d: Form or call: we capture your needs (dates, volume, floors, access).
Process.s2d: We assess cubic metres and equipment needed for an accurate quote.
Process.s3d: We set the date and time based on your availability.
Process.s4d: Move and delivery with care, insurance and support through handover.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.item1Answer: Yes. The quote is free, with no obligation, and valid for 30 days. Call Monday to Saturday, 8:00–19:00, or use the form, which is open 24/7.
Faq.item2Answer: Yes. Professional insurance covers the goods carried. Limits and exclusions are on the quote.
Faq.item3Answer: Yes. We are based in Marseille and work across France on quotation. Long-distance jobs, including abroad, are also quoted.
Faq.item4Question: How should I prepare for my move?
Faq.item4Answer: After the quote is accepted, we set the date and share preparation notes: packing, access and parking. The quote states what is included.
Faq.item5Answer: The price is shown excluding VAT, and the quote also shows the VAT-inclusive amount. It covers labour, the vehicle and insurance. It depends on volume in m³, fragility, floor and distance.
Faq.item6Answer: Either a deposit or a single payment. The timing is the one stated on the quote.
Faq.item7Answer: Cancellation and postponement terms are those stated on the quote.
Faq.item8Question: How long do I have to make a complaint?
Faq.item8Answer: Any complaint must be sent in writing to ARM Services within 8 days after the job.

Terms.metaDescription: General terms of sale and service for ARM Services moving company.
Terms.h1: General terms of sale and service
Terms.s1p1: These general terms apply to all moving and related services offered by ARM Services, a SAS (SIRET 938 889 334 00018), without restriction. Any quote or order implies acceptance of these terms.
Terms.s2p1: Quotes from ARM Services are free and valid for 30 days from issue. The order is firm when the quote is accepted and, where applicable, when the deposit stated on the quote is paid.
Terms.s2p2: Material changes (volume, dates, addresses) after acceptance may require a pricing amendment.
Terms.s3p1: Prices are in euros excluding VAT. Each quote also shows the VAT-inclusive amount. The price covers labour, the vehicle and professional insurance of the goods carried. It is calculated from volume (m³), fragility, floor and distance.
Terms.s3p2: Payment is either a deposit or a single payment. The timing is the one stated on the quote.
Terms.s4p1: Cancellation and postponement terms are those stated on the quote.
Terms.s5p1: Professional insurance covers the goods carried. Limits, exclusions and how to report a claim are on the quote.
Terms.s5p2: The client declares valuable or fragile items. Declared-value insurance, when offered, is stated on the quote.
Terms.s6p1: The client agrees to: provide accurate information (volume, access, floors), ensure premises are available on agreed dates, prepare goods per any instructions (disconnecting, simple dismantling), and not hand over prohibited goods (hazardous materials, cash, etc.).
Terms.s7p1: Any complaint must be sent in writing to ARM Services within 8 days after the job.
Terms.s8p1: These terms are governed by French law. In a dispute, the parties first seek an amicable solution. Failing that, the French courts have jurisdiction.
